Project Overview

Building a Recognizable Educational Identity

Dr. Mohamed Soliman is an educational personal brand focused on teaching ACT and EST Biology.

The project involved establishing a new visual identity that reflects the scientific nature of the subject while presenting the educator through a professional and contemporary brand image. The goal was to communicate scientific knowledge, clarity, confidence, and an encouraging educational character through a cohesive identity system.

The Challenge

The starting point was the absence of an established visual identity for the educational brand. The challenge was to create a clear visual representation of a specialized biology educator, connecting the scientific subject with a professional and approachable educational personality.

Brand Personality

Trustworthy, scientific, clear, professional, modern, and motivating.

Brand Values

Trust, scientific excellence, clarity, professionalism, modernity, and motivation.

Target Audience

Students preparing for ACT and EST Biology examinations, seeking clear explanations, deeper understanding, and structured practice.

Brand Direction

Trust & Credibility

A professional visual presence that supports confidence in the educational brand.

Motivation & Progress

An encouraging character that reflects the learning journey and pursuit of academic achievement.

04 / 10

Creative Concept

Scientific Symbols Meet Personal Identity

THE CORE IDEA
The central logo concept combines scientific elements with the educator's name to create a visual identity directly connected to biology. The microscope represents observation, research, and discovery; the DNA structure represents life and biological composition; and the cell element reinforces the identity's connection to the discipline.

Together, these elements connect the educator's personal identity with his field of specialization through a distinctive and recognizable visual mark.

05 / 10

Logo Development

Developing a Scientific Personal Brand Mark

Scientific Symbolism

Integrating the microscope, DNA structure, and cell-inspired details into one cohesive mark.

Arabic Name & Composition

Balancing the Arabic name with the scientific symbol while maintaining readability and visual harmony.

Color & Supporting Details

Using deep navy and emerald green to establish a professional scientific character with clear visual contrast.

06 / 10

Logo System

A Structured Bilingual Logo System

Logo Configurations

Primary Arabic logo, horizontal secondary configuration, and standalone microscope icon.

Monochrome Versions

Black and white logo variations designed for clear reproduction across different backgrounds.

Logo Specifications

Construction grid, clear-space rules, correct usage examples, and incorrect usage guidance help maintain the logo's proportions and legibility.

07 / 10

Visual Identity System

A Scientific Visual Language

Color Palette

The palette combines deep navy blue (#0D2F4F) with emerald green (#16A085), supported by lighter turquoise, neutral gray, dark gray, and white tones. Together, these colors communicate scientific professionalism, clarity, and a contemporary educational character.

Navy Blue#1F3657
Gold#D4A24C
Soft Cream#F5F2EB
Deep Slate#2B2E34
Muted Blue#5C6F82
Light Gold#E8C98A

Typography & Graphic Elements

IBM Plex Sans Arabic supports clear Arabic communication, while Montserrat provides a contemporary English typographic structure. Biology-inspired elements—including DNA structures, microscopes, cell symbols, and educational icons—extend the identity beyond the logo.

Social Media Design Exploration

Exploring Educational Content Formats

DIGITAL COMMUNICATION

Content Direction

A collection of experimental social media designs explores how the visual identity can support educational communication. The designs cover biology concepts, explanations, study guidance, motivational messages, and subject-related visual storytelling, using consistent typography, colors, patterns, and logo placement.

10 / 10

Final Brand Presentation

A Recognizable Identity for an Educational Biology Brand

The identity brings together a scientific logo concept, a distinctive color palette, bilingual typography, biology-inspired graphic elements, and a coherent visual system for an ACT & EST Biology educator.

The final identity establishes a recognizable visual foundation for Dr. Mohamed Soliman's specialization in ACT and EST Biology. The project was approved by the client without further modifications. The completed delivery included the logo files and brand guidelines; the additional applications and social media visuals are conceptual demonstrations.
